source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Check the [objective markers](vsdata:core-rule/objectives) you hold as your Command phase ends. A marker qualifies if a unit with Computational Mastermind is in range of that marker. Per qualifying marker, you may earn 1 YP or pay 1 YP. Apply these choices before [Prioritised Efficiency](vsdata:ability/leagues-of-votann.prioritised-efficiency) decides whether your units use **Fortify Takeover** or **Hostile Acquisition**.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
